title: Native Algorithm Rest Adapter
description: Add nativeAlgorithmAdapter.ts in semio/algorithms calling REST for python/go/rust and @semio/js for ts; wire Storybook language decorator and engine FastAPI routes end-to-end.
summary: Added semio/algorithms/nativeAlgorithmAdapter.ts routing TypeScript to @semio/js and other languages to POST /api/native-algorithms/execute. Engine FastAPI now exposes that route with CORS, Python semio_core dispatch, and Go/Rust subprocess bridges (cmd/nativebridge, cargo native_bridge). Storybook proxies /api to the engine and Delete/Flatten stories load flatten/delete via the adapter using the language toolbar.
